info.title: dotnet-csverify
info.description: The CsVerify verifier: proves C# code's CsVerify specifications (contracts, loop invariants, termination, views) with Z3, and erases the proofs. Run "dotnet csverify", or build with -p:CsVerifyEnabled=true.

options.name: --no-overflow
options.description:
treat every integer as mathematical (unsound where code can overflow); by default
run-time arithmetic is C#'s: overflow is reported unless checked (throws) or
unchecked (wraps on purpose)

options.name: --nullable
options.description:
nullable context: enable (default), disable, annotations, warnings; only
non-nullable reference types are known not to be null

options.name: -d
options.description: extra preprocessor symbol (CSVERIFY_SPEC is always defined)

options.name: --smt-log
options.description: write the SMT-LIB2 conversation with Z3

options.name: --only
options.description: verify only the methods whose name (Type.Method) contains the text (repeatable)

options.name: -v
options.description:
list every method with its proved obligations, and the library contracts
([ContractsFor] stubs, trusted) the proofs assumed

options.name: --help
options.description:
this text
csverify erase --out <dir> ...   writes the program with every proof erased (csverify erase -h)
